title: Flood forecasting using a physics-guided conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model
abstract: arXiv:2611.31212v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: High-resolution flood forecasting with full two-dimensional shallow water equation (SWE) solvers remains computationally expensive, even on GPUs. We develop a conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) that forecasts the evolution of 30 m water-depth fields over a four-day horizon for the Des Plaines River watershed, Illinois. The model is trained on SynxFlow SWE simulations of 113 historical storms observed across twelve Midwestern states (2003-2024), each under three antecedent-wetness scenarios, and can optionally be conditioned on coarse 100 m or 150 m hydrodynamic simulations. Because reverse diffusion is stochastic, every forecast is a 20-member ensemble drawn from the same trained model. Coarse conditioning reduces the four-day mean water-depth RMSE of the ensemble mean from 0.170 m to 0.054 m (100 m) and 0.048 m (150 m). translated_title: 基于物理引导的条件去噪扩散概率模型的洪水预报
translated_abstract: 使用完整的二维浅水方程（SWE）求解器进行高分辨率洪水预报，即使在GPU上计算成本仍然十分高昂。我们开发了一种条件去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM），用于预测伊利诺伊州德斯普兰尼斯河流域30米分辨率水深场在四天时间范围内的演变。该模型基于2003至2024年间在美国中西部十二个州观测到的113场历史风暴的SynxFlow SWE模拟进行训练，每场风暴均在三种前期湿润度情景下模拟，并且可以选择性地以粗分辨率的100米或150米水动力模拟作为条件。由于逆向扩散过程具有随机性，每次预报都是从同一训练模型中抽取的20个成员组成的集合预报。粗分辨率条件化使集合平均的四天平均水深RMSE从0.170米降至0.054米（100米条件）和0.048米（150米条件）。更粗的150米条件化还提供了最佳的临界成功指数（0.839）和最低的误报率……
tldr: 该论文开发了一种基于物理引导的条件去噪扩散概率模型，可高效生成30米分辨率、四天时间范围的洪水集合预报，并通过粗分辨率水动力模拟条件化将平均水深RMSE从0.170米降至0.048米，大幅降低计算成本的同时保持甚至超越了传统浅水方程求解器的精度。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a physics-guided conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model for efficient 30 m resolution ensemble flood forecasting over a four-day horizon, reducing mean water-depth RMSE from 0.170 m to 0.048 m when conditioned on coarse hydrodynamic simulations while drastically cutting computational cost.
